blurb: Oceanview Helicopters operates MD500D helicopters equipped for specialized operations including wildlife capture, aerial photography, and patient transport. They have over twenty years of experience with the MD500D and offer various equipment options such as baggage pods, auxiliary fuel tanks, and litter kits. Their crews have conducted extensive wildlife capture projects in BC and Alberta.
